description.text: The program is designed to educate advanced specialized personnel to do business and management in international companies and conduct teaching and research on international trade.

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at China Pharmaceutical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2638 USD/per year ￥ 19000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school5. English language certificate6. completed foreigner physical examination form 7. Non-criminal certificate8. Family financial statement

requirements.text: Applicants are required to have graduated from High School.Applicants must be at least 18 years of age at the start of the course and healthy.Minimum Chinese language requirement: HSK4 and above (for Chinese-taught programs).Minimum English language requirement: IELTS 6.5 or above or IBT 90 or above (for English-taught programs).Non-criminal record.Financial statement.
